context_label.he: תגובה בלינקדאין על פוסט בנושא סוכני AI
context_label.en: LinkedIn comment on a post about AI agents

cards.text: We shipped an agent to handle inbound support last quarter. It deflects maybe 40% of tickets but the ones it gets wrong it gets VERY wrong. Still worth it, just not the magic people sell on here.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: הפרטים הספציפיים והמספרים הלא מעוגלים מאפיינים כתיבה אנושית.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: specific numbers and a complaint in the middle - humans hedge with details, AI stays smooth.

context_label.he: תגובה בלינקדאין על פוסט בנושא סוכני AI
context_label.en: LinkedIn comment on a post about AI agents

cards.text: AI agents are transforming how teams handle support. Companies that adopt early will build a real advantage, while those that wait risk falling behind. The key is starting small and iterating fast.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: אף מספר, אף דוגמה, אף דעה אמיתית - רק קלישאות נכונות.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: no numbers, no example, no actual opinion - just correct-sounding generalities.

context_label.en: Reply to a tweet about remote work

cards.text: been remote since 2019 and honestly the biggest loss is the random hallway stuff. my best project at my last job started because i overheard two engineers arguing about a schema at the coffee machine

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: אותיות קטנות, בלי ניקוד, וסיפור אנקדוטלי ספציפי - חתימה אנושית קלאסית.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: lowercase, no punctuation, one oddly specific anecdote - classic human typing.

context_label.en: Reply to a tweet about remote work

cards.text: Remote work offers flexibility, but it also requires discipline and clear communication. The most successful remote teams invest in async culture and intentional connection. Balance is everything.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: 'Balance is everything' - סיומת מוטיבציונית ריקה היא סימן היכר של מודל.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: 'Balance is everything' - an empty motivational closer is a model signature.

context_label.he: הודעה בקבוצת וואטסאפ על כלי ניהול משימות
context_label.en: WhatsApp message in a group about task management tools

cards.text: I've tried every todo app. Notion, Things, Todoist, a paper notebook, back to Todoist. The app was never the problem. I was the problem. Currently on week 3 of a spreadsheet and it's going okay-ish.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: ביקורת עצמית וסוף לא מסודר ('okay-ish') - AI כמעט לא כותב ככה.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: self-deprecation plus an unresolved ending ('okay-ish') - AI almost never leaves it messy like that.

context_label.he: תגובה בלינקדאין על פוסט בנושא גיוס עובדים
context_label.en: LinkedIn comment on a post about hiring

cards.text: Hiring is the most important function in any company. The best founders spend half their time on it. Culture is set by the first ten hires, and every compromise compounds from there.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: שלושה משפטים, שלוש קלישאות, אפס חוויה אישית.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: three sentences, three cliches, zero personal experience.

context_label.he: תגובה בלינקדאין על פוסט בנושא גיוס עובדים
context_label.en: LinkedIn comment on a post about hiring

cards.text: we hired a guy once who aced every interview and then couldn't ship anything for 3 months. now our process is basically: paid trial week or nothing. interviews measure interviewing.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: 'interviews measure interviewing' - ניסוח חד שמגיע מניסיון, לא מסיכום.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: 'interviews measure interviewing' - a sharp line earned from experience, plus a concrete fix.

context_label.he: תגובה לצייץ על מחירי דירות בתל אביב
context_label.en: Reply to a tweet about Tel Aviv rent prices

cards.text: The rental market in Tel Aviv reflects broader economic trends. High demand and limited supply naturally push prices upward. Policymakers should consider incentives for new construction.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: נשמע כמו כתבה כלכלית, לא כמו בן אדם שמשלם שכר דירה.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: reads like an economics column, not like a person who actually pays rent.

context_label.he: תגובה לצייץ על מחירי דירות בתל אביב
context_label.en: Reply to a tweet about Tel Aviv rent prices

cards.text: my landlord raised rent 18% this year and the elevator has been broken since march. but sure, 'market trends'. i'm one more increase away from moving back in with my parents at 31

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: ציניות + פרטים קטנים ומעצבנים (המעלית) = בן אדם.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: sarcasm plus small annoying details (the elevator) = human.

context_label.en: WhatsApp message in a founders group

cards.text: Shut down my first startup in 2016 after 2 years. The hardest part wasn't telling investors, it was telling the team. Two of them had turned down Google offers to join. I still think about that.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: פרט כואב וספציפי ('turned down Google offers') שאף מודל לא היה ממציא בלי פרומפט.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: a specific painful detail ('turned down Google offers') no model invents unprompted.

context_label.he: תגובה בלינקדאין על פוסט בנושא פיטורים בהייטק
context_label.en: LinkedIn comment on a post about tech layoffs

cards.text: Layoffs are never easy, but they are sometimes necessary for long-term sustainability. Companies that handle them with transparency and empathy maintain trust. Leadership matters most in hard times.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: טון של ייעוץ ארגוני, אפס אנשים אמיתיים בטקסט.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: consulting-deck tone, zero actual people in the text.

context_label.he: תגובה בלינקדאין על פוסט בנושא פיטורים בהייטק
context_label.en: LinkedIn comment on a post about tech layoffs

cards.text: got laid off over a 4 minute zoom with 200 other people. they read from a script. my manager found out the same morning i did. anyway, i'm fine, but i'll never believe an 'all hands' invite again

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: הפרט '4 דקות בזום עם 200 איש' ספציפי מדי מכדי להיות מומצא.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: '4 minute zoom with 200 other people' is too specific to be invented.

context_label.he: תגובה לצייץ על שעות מסך לילדים
context_label.en: Reply to a tweet about kids and screen time

cards.text: Screen time is a nuanced topic. Not all screen use is equal - educational content differs from passive scrolling. Parents should focus on balance and co-viewing rather than strict limits.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: 'nuanced topic' - המודל תמיד פותח בגישוש. אף הורה אמיתי לא מדבר ככה.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: 'nuanced topic' - the model always hedges first. No real parent talks like this.

context_label.he: תגובה לצייץ על שעות מסך לילדים
context_label.en: Reply to a tweet about kids and screen time

cards.text: we had all these rules about screens and then our second kid was born and the ipad basically became a third parent for 6 months. she's fine. we're all fine. the rules are gone though

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: וידוי קטן ומביך + 'the rules are gone though' - הומור עצמי שמודל לא מייצר.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: a small embarrassing confession plus 'the rules are gone though' - self-aware humor models don't produce.

context_label.en: WhatsApp message in a group about coffee

cards.text: Bought a cheap burr grinder after years of pre-ground and it genuinely changed my mornings. Not a snob about it, still use a basic drip machine. But fresh grounds, man. That's the whole upgrade.

tell.he: PLACEHOLDER TELL: 'man' באמצע משפט והמלצה צנועה - רגיסטר של פורום אמיתי.
tell.en: PLACEHOLDER TELL: mid-sentence 'man' and a modest recommendation - real forum register.
